# Vendored graph layout sources

Third-party C++ that `build.rs` compiles into the backend for
`POST /api/graph-layout` ([HTTP API](../../../protocol/http-api.md#graph-layout)),
which lays out the Backtraces Flow graph and the Sources Graph view. Every file
under `triskel/` and `fmt/` is an unmodified copy of the upstream release named
below; none is edited, reformatted or regenerated by hand.

| Directory | Project | Upstream | Revision | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `triskel/` | Triskel, a control flow graph layout engine (SESE regions and Sugiyama layering) | <https://github.com/triskellib/triskel> | commit `196ba112eba992c1460af3097c038defcf7a7e45` | MPL-2.0, [`triskel/LICENSE`](triskel/LICENSE) |
| `fmt/` | {fmt}, the formatting library Triskel uses, header only (`FMT_HEADER_ONLY`) | <https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt> | release `12.2.0` | MIT, [`fmt/LICENSE`](fmt/LICENSE) |

## Upstream archives

| Archive | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| `https://github.com/triskellib/triskel/archive/196ba112eba992c1460af3097c038defcf7a7e45.tar.gz` | `41f09134ac8c57bb1cab14437ad49437b516f3c8427d466d28f89cfecc50ce47` |
| `https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/releases/download/12.2.0/fmt-12.2.0.zip` | `a2f4a8d51178f954e4c339007f77edd76ba0cb2e36f87a48e5a5403d9be5878f` |

The fmt digest is also the one Homebrew's `fmt` 12.2.0 formula pins.

## File list

- `triskel/LICENSE`, `triskel/lib/include/**`, and `triskel/lib/src/**`
  except `lib/src/renderer/` (Cairo and Dear ImGui drawing) and `lib/src/llvm/`
  (LLVM IR input). The `CMakeLists.txt` files come along unchanged and are not
  used; `build.rs` compiles every `.cpp` under `triskel/lib/src`.
- `fmt/LICENSE` and `fmt/include/fmt/*.h`. No fmt source file is compiled.

The packaged app ships both license texts as
`Contents/Resources/GraphLayoutLicenses.txt`, written by
[`build-research-app.sh`](../../../scripts/build-research-app.sh), with a notice
of where the MPL-2.0 source is.

## Why it runs in a worker

Triskel runs on graphs shaped by captured pages, and it is built with `NDEBUG`,
so its asserts are not a safety net. The server never calls it: each request
gets a contained `origin-trace-backend --graph-layout-worker` process with no
network access (on macOS no file access either), a resident memory limit, a budget per graph and a
request deadline ([`src/graph_layout.rs`](../src/graph_layout.rs)). Defects
found in this revision while building that route:

- Its SESE pass orients a region by an undirected depth-first search. When that
  search first reaches a region through its exit edge, which happens where
  branches join, the region is rooted at its exit, cycle removal misses the
  region's loop, and layer assignment (`init_rank` in
  `lib/src/layout/sugiyama/network_simplex.cpp`) never returns. The route gives
  such a graph `timeout` once its budget passes and lays out the rest.
- It throws `EMPTY BL` unless one root reaches every node and every node reaches
  a node without out-edges. The worker adds a virtual root and, when needed, a
  virtual exit, and drops both from the result.
- It can place nodes on top of each other, mostly in large or unstructured
  graphs, and returns some reversed edges target first. The worker reverses
  those edges and reports a graph with overlapping nodes or a detached edge as
  `failed`.
- `Layout::remove_small_regions` keeps a reference to a deque element after
  `pop_back`; AddressSanitizer reports it on most graphs.

## Repository checks

The repository's own C++ format check and agent preflight skip this directory
([`mk/config.mk`](../../../mk/config.mk),
[`tools/agent-preflight.sh`](../../../tools/agent-preflight.sh)), and
[`.gitattributes`](../../../.gitattributes) turns off whitespace checks for it,
since upstream `fmt/color.h` has trailing spaces. The hygiene scan's size and
secret checks still cover it.

## Verify or update

To check the copy against upstream, or to move to a new revision:

```sh
rev=196ba112eba992c1460af3097c038defcf7a7e45
work="$(mktemp -d)"
curl -fsSL -o "$work/triskel.tar.gz" "https://github.com/triskellib/triskel/archive/$rev.tar.gz"
shasum -a 256 "$work/triskel.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$work/triskel.tar.gz" -C "$work"
diff -r "$work/triskel-$rev/lib/include" triskel/lib/include
diff -r -x renderer -x llvm "$work/triskel-$rev/lib/src" triskel/lib/src
cmp "$work/triskel-$rev/LICENSE" triskel/LICENSE

curl -fsSL -o "$work/fmt.zip" https://github.com/fmtlib/fmt/releases/download/12.2.0/fmt-12.2.0.zip
shasum -a 256 "$work/fmt.zip"
unzip -q "$work/fmt.zip" -d "$work"
diff -r "$work/fmt-12.2.0/include/fmt" fmt/include/fmt
cmp "$work/fmt-12.2.0/LICENSE" fmt/LICENSE
```

Run it from this directory; every `diff` and `cmp` prints nothing when the copy
is unmodified. To update, replace the directories with the same file list from
the new archives, then change together: the revisions and digests here,
`ENGINE_REVISION` in `src/graph_layout.rs`, `triskel_revision` and the fmt
version in `scripts/build-research-app.sh`, the revision in
[`protocol/http-api.md`](../../../protocol/http-api.md#graph-layout) and the
route test in `tests/http.rs`. Then run the `graph_layout` unit tests, whose
seeded random graphs and recorded failure cases show whether the new revision
changes any of the defects above, and the full gate from
[`AGENTS.md`](../../../AGENTS.md).
